desc: Prove the interval invariant and greedy closure characterization.
Establish correctness for strict inequality, endpoint equality, and absorption order.
Prove that consecutive expanding phases at least double the current size, giving \(O(\log \sum A)\) phases per start.
Derive a scalable all-start algorithm; do not rely on the current \(O(N\log N\log\sum A)\) approach.
Implement the scalable algorithm with efficient memory and output handling.
Validate on both samples and adversarial arrays, including equal, monotone, dominant-barrier, and opposite-side-unlocking cases.
